orientation: outside half: rotation 0, outward is UP: nozzles point up into space; the exhaust glow overhangs above the frame (see glow.offset); the bottom 4px are the flange onto the outer wall face
notes: Concord Thruster Mk4, a hull mount (outward is up): the 4x3 nozzle housing: two heavy bells with heat-sink fins on a reinforced collar plate with an amber stripe, a taller middle nozzle between them; inside the Mk3 core with an amber-framed hatch, armour corner plates and a finned heat sink in place of the vent grille. Damaged: the left bell lip dented and hanging, the right bell cracked and sputtering, a fin torn off, the middle nozzle cracked, sparks. Disabled: both bells bent over at the neck, the middle nozzle snapped, the fins gone, the collar cracked. THIS FILE: the OUTSIDE half (nozzles, in space against the outer wall face; its bottom 4px are the flange onto the wall). It is never destroyed, only disabled (bent, dead, fixable).
